faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is conducted by the All India Institute of Medical Sciences Delhi (AIIMS Delhi) for a project under the CIMR initiative.

faq.question: Q2. What is the name of the post advertised?
faq.answer: The advertised post is Research Associate – II under advertisement number N-2436 on a contractual employment type.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available for this recruitment?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy available for the Research Associate – II post in this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q4. What is the educational qualification required?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess an MBBS/BDS degree with three years of experience or an MBBS/BDS degree with an MPH/Ph.D. or equivalent degree.

faq.question: Q5. What is the maximum age limit to apply?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for applicants is 40 years, with age relaxations applicable for reserved categories as per government rules.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary offered for this position?
faq.answer: Selected candidates for the Research Associate – II post will receive a salary of ₹61,000 per month plus 30% HRA.

faq.question: Q7. What is the last date to submit the application?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application via email is 07-10-2026. Candidates must ensure timely submission before the deadline.

faq.question: Q8. What is the mode of application?
faq.answer: The mode of application is strictly via email. Candidates need to send their detailed CV and documents to the designated email address.

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process for this job?
faq.answer: The selection process comprises the initial screening of Curriculum Vitae (CV) followed by an interview of the shortlisted candidates.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official website and notification?
faq.answer: You can visit the official AIIMS Delhi website at www.aiims.edu and check the notification PDF link provided in the important links section.
